exposure: Previous wedge resection for interstitial pregnancy
Frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) cycles of IVF/ICSI
cohort: 75 women with a previous history of wedge resection for interstitial pregnancy and 375 control subjects without any previous history of ectopic pregnancy
finding: Women with previous wedge resection for interstitial pregnancy had higher rates of ectopic pregnancy and uterine rupture but no significant differences in clinical pregnancy rate, live birth rate, or most neonatal outcomes compared to controls.
